rationale: The problem is flow and waste in a treatment pathway: most elapsed time is waiting for consent (c1), and lean redesign of the clinic day has raised chair utilisation in the same setting (c4). Value stream mapping finds the waits and rework; test cycles introduce the combined form (c2), the need-ordered call list and the staining leaflet. Two strands are kept apart by design: a measurement strand with its own primary measure, reported by home language (c5), and a conversation strand with its own primary finding on acceptability, including front-tooth staining (c3). They are compared side by side, not merged into one verdict.
alternatives: Comparison of schools with and without the redesign (refused: the programme will redesign all clinics and has no research grant)
Consent form change alone (refused: waiting for children in class and staining calls would remain)
Measurement strand only (refused: acceptability and fairness are half of the programme's question)
whyNotMoreComplex: A formal integrated mixed design with joint displays would add analysis time the programme does not have; side-by-side reporting of two pre-specified strands answers the question.

decision.statement: Redesign the SDF pathway in the 23 school clinics with lean methods, testing a combined consent form with a staining photograph, a need-ordered call list and a staining leaflet, and judge it by two separate strands: timely SDF by home language, and the acceptability of the pathway to parents, teachers and therapists.
decision.question: Should the programme redesign its SDF pathway with lean methods and evaluate it in two separate strands?

criteria.text: Consent is the main source of delay, a combined form raised return elsewhere, and lean redesign improved clinic flow in the same setting.
Families find staining so unacceptable that informed refusals outweigh the gains in timely treatment.

gates.requirement: Research ethics committee approval for the service evaluation and the structured conversations
gates.evidence: Approval PHU-REC-2026-22 dated 2026-09-15, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Permission to use programme screening and treatment records for evaluation
gates.evidence: School board data-sharing agreement SB-DSA-2025-09, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: School board approval of the combined consent form

decision.note: Rests on ledger claims c1 to c4 from retrieved records; the combined form is not approved yet, so the action stays blocked.

summary: Lean redesign recommended with two separate strands; the decision rests on four ledger claims and waits for approval of the combined form.
